headline:
김택연, 변화구를
더 정교하게 다듬는다

sourceRoles.primary: Exact primary field interview; individual remarks are attributed to this source alone.
sourceRoles.secondary: Independent Newsis report supports club camp dates/roster/training operation only. Does not independently corroborate exclusive individual remarks.
